description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima.
Choose to have Sakashima enter the battlefield as a copy of Gilraen.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Activate Sakashima by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Gilraen.
When Gilraen enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Human and/or Noble you control.
Repeat.
If you control one additional Human and/or Noble, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.
